description: Multinomial logit where the reference class lo is absent for z1 > 0.7. Split-search candidates at or above the last lo observation have a right child without lo, fitted with mid as reference (objective only, no coefficients or scores). The tree splits there, and that leaf stops with stop_reason no_estfun (model_info status reference_absent). See reference_absent.
r_call: partykit::mob(formula = y ~ x | z1 + z2 + z3, data = sim_multinom_noref, fit = multinomfit, maxit = 1000L, reltol = 1e-16, abstol = 1e-04, control = partykit::mob_control(alpha = 0.05, bonferroni = TRUE, minsize = 60L, maxdepth = Inf, mtry = Inf, trim = 0.1, breakties = FALSE, parm = NULL, dfsplit = TRUE, prune = NULL, restart = TRUE, verbose = FALSE, caseweights = TRUE, ytype = "vector", xtype = "matrix", terminal = c("estfun", "object"), inner = c("estfun", "object"), model = TRUE, numsplit = "left", catsplit = "binary", vcov = "opg", ordinal = "chisq", nrep = 10000, applyfun = NULL, cores = NULL))
response_encoding: multinomial: class labels; the first level is the reference class

reference_absent.description: Root split search on z1 refitted side by side with multinomfit. candidates lists every candidate in split_search order; admissible ones (objective not null) have each side's status and objective, whose sum equals the split-search objective (max relative difference in sides_vs_split_search_max_rel). status reference_absent means the side has no lo observation: its objective is that of multinom fitted with the first present class as reference, and it has no coefficients or scores.
